Open session list, press Cmd/Ctrl+Tab - should move to next session
Check cheat sheet shows all shortcuts
incentive: Keyboard shortcuts enable power-user workflows; must not conflict with system shortcuts.

title: Empty state: no sessions yet with clear call-to-action to create first session
intent: Guide new user to create first session when no sessions exist.
acceptance: Empty state shows when no saved sessions exist
Message: 'No saved sessions yet.'
Sub-message: 'Create a new session to get started.'
Button: 'Create Session' is prominent and centered
Button links to agent picker or new session flow
Mobile: empty state message and button readable, not clipped
anti_patterns: empty state takes up entire screen with white space
no action available - user stuck in empty view

interactions.expected: agent picker opens or session creation flow starts

manual_simulation: Mobile: verify message and button visible and not clipped
incentive: Empty state is first impression; must guide user smoothly into creating first session.

title: Error state: agent crashed or disconnected with recovery options
intent: Show clear error message when agent fails with retry button and diagnostic info.
acceptance: Error banner shows when agent disconnects or crashes
Error message explains what happened (transport down, agent crashed, etc.)
Retry button visible and functional
Diagnostic button shows error details (logs, trace ID)
Error persists until retry succeeds or user dismisses
Mobile: error banner doesn't cover input field or controls
anti_patterns: no retry button or button disabled
diagnostic info locked behind dev tools

interactions.expected: reconnect attempt starts, error clears on success
modal shows error details and trace ID

manual_simulation: Kill agent process while session active
Verify error banner shows with clear message
Click diagnostic, verify error details and trace ID shown
incentive: Error state is critical for trust; users must understand what failed and how to recover.

title: Mobile-friendly session view: responsive layout, keyboard-safe input, touch-friendly
intent: Ensure core session view works on phone and tablet without requiring desktop mode.
acceptance: Session list readable on 320px width (iPhone SE)
Messages not overlapped by soft keyboard
Input field remains visible when keyboard open
Buttons touch-friendly (min 44px height)
Sidebar collapses to drawer on narrow layout
Horizontal scroll not needed for core interaction
Mobile: no pinch-zoom required to interact
anti_patterns: sidebar always visible, pushing chat off-screen on mobile
horizontal scroll required to see full message

interactions.action: click on mobile to open drawer
interactions.expected: sidebar slides in from left

manual_simulation: Type message, keyboard appears - input remains visible
Tap send button, verify it's easy to tap
Check sidebar drawer opens on mobile
Rotate device, verify layout adjusts correctly
incentive: Mobile support is essential for agents on-the-go; must work without friction on phones.

title: Accessibility: screen reader support for streamed messages, keyboard navigation
intent: Ensure live messages are announced by screen readers and all controls keyboard accessible.
acceptance: aria-live='polite' on message container for screen reader announcement
Tab order follows visual flow
All buttons and inputs labeled with aria-label or associated label
Close button and escape key dismiss modals
Keyboard can navigate all controls without mouse
anti_patterns: no aria-live, screen reader doesn't announce new messages
modal can't be dismissed with Escape
color-only indication of state (e.g., red text only for error)

interactions.action: press Tab, verify focus moves to send button
interactions.expected: focus order is logical

manual_simulation: Test with screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver)
Send message, verify screen reader announces it
Tab through all controls, verify order makes sense
Check all buttons have accessible names
incentive: Accessibility ensures inclusive experience for all users; screen reader support is table-stakes.

title: Plan section highlight and marker
intent: Let users visually mark important sections of a plan with colored highlights and maintain context while reviewing
acceptance: Highlight can be applied to any block in parsed markdown; colors persist across versions; exporting annotations includes highlight text; highlight does not block plan approval
anti_patterns: highlights lost when plan version increments
highlights applied to DOM but not persisted to storage
manual text restoration fails on line wrapping
interactions: select text → toolbar appears → choose color → highlight applied
hover highlighted section → delete button visible
plan shared via URL → highlights restored in receiver's browser
critique_focus: Selection API robustness; cross-tab state consistency; text restoration edge cases (soft line breaks, unicode)
manual_simulation: 1. Load plan with 3+ sections. 2. Highlight heading and first list item in different colors. 3. Switch versions, return. 4. Highlights present, no flashing. 5. Share URL, verify colors in new tab.
incentive: Reviewers can signal key changes, missing rationale, architectural concerns without blocking

title: Inline comment on plan block
intent: Attach structured feedback to a specific section without deleting content, e.g., 'expand this rationale', 'add error handling', 'check deps with X'
acceptance: Comment created by selecting text + toolbar → 'comment' type; comment text saved; popover edit/delete; comment visible as margin badge (icon + count); global comment pool shows all; exporting shows comment + selected text
anti_patterns: comments lost on plan version update without diff-context tracking
popover blocks ability to scroll plan
comment without selected text cannot be linked to intent
exported comment lacks source section context
interactions: select section → toolbar shows types (deletion, comment, global) → pick 'comment' → enter text → save
hover comment badge → popover shows text + author + created time → edit/delete
critique_focus: Popover positioning under nested sections; text restoration reliability after comment edit; batch-comment workflows
manual_simulation: 1. Select first 3 lines of a section. 2. Add comment 'unclear motivation'. 3. Switch plan version. 4. Comment persists with version context. 5. Share plan, verify comment in receiver's UI.
incentive: Non-blocking feedback loop; agent can refine without full plan rejection

title: Suggest content removal from plan
intent: Mark a section as 'should be deleted' without requiring agent to resubmit; enables quick 'cut this, too verbose' feedback
acceptance: DELETION annotation spans a block or multi-line selection; marked with strikethrough in view; export lists all deletions by block; agent sees 'remove lines 12-15' in feedback; plan can be approved with deletions marked (not auto-applied)
anti_patterns: deletion annotations cannot be toggled off while reviewing (must re-select)
deletion of heading leaves orphan subsections
DELETION cannot be undone after export without re-editing plan
interactions: select section → toolbar → choose 'deletion' → section marked with strikethrough + red border
hover deleted section → 'undo deletion' button appears
critique_focus: Multi-block deletion spanning headings and nested lists; deletion undo/redo; export order (deletions first vs position-preserving)
manual_simulation: 1. Load plan with nested steps. 2. Delete second step entirely, comment on third step. 3. Approve plan with mixed annotations. 4. Verify feedback lists deletion before comments. 5. Agent receives clear deletion guidance.
incentive: Reviewers can mark obvious cuts without forcing agent to guess; plan approval is not binary (can have feedback + approve)

title: Global plan comment (top-level feedback)
intent: Add a comment not tied to any specific block, e.g., 'check with @alice', 'this solves problem X', 'needs trace for audit'
acceptance: Global comment accessible via button in top toolbar or sidebar; stored as AnnotationType.GLOBAL_COMMENT with blockId=null; rendered above/below plan; exporting includes as summary comment; multiple global comments supported
anti_patterns: global comment overwrites previous on save (only one allowed)
global comment not visible until sidebar opened
export format confuses global vs block-level comments
interactions: click 'Add comment' button in top toolbar → modal appears → text input → save
sidebar Global Comments tab shows all global comments
export → first line: '[Global Comment] user feedback here' before plan content
critique_focus: Modal positioning on mobile; batch global comment workflows; reply-threading (future); audit trail for changes
manual_simulation: 1. Open plan in review UI. 2. Click top 'Comment' button. 3. Enter 'Defer error handling to follow-up task'. 4. Save and share URL. 5. Receiver sees global comment above plan.
incentive: Reviewers can add context that spans multiple sections or applies to whole plan

title: Explicit plan approval or rejection with reason
intent: Reviewer must make binary decision: approve (allow plan to execute) or deny (request agent to refine); reason captured for audit
acceptance: Two buttons in toolbar: 'Approve' and 'Request Changes'; deny opens modal for required reason; reason + all annotations exported in single feedback packet; hookSpecificOutput includes decision behavior; both paths preserve plan version/author; decision timestamp logged
anti_patterns: deny without reason allowed (no audit trail)
decision buttons visible when no changes loaded (ambiguous)
deny reason not included in agent feedback
interactions: review complete → pick 'Approve' → plan exits review UI, agent continues
or pick 'Request Changes' → modal: reason required → 'These steps are out of order. Reorder A→B→C.' → submit → agent receives feedback
deny modal shows preview of all annotations being sent
critique_focus: Deny reason character limits; modal accessibility; preventing accidental approval; keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+Enter for approve)
manual_simulation: 1. Load plan with 2 comments and 1 deletion. 2. Click 'Request Changes'. 3. Reason text required → 'Reordering needed, see annotations'. 4. Click submit. 5. Verify feedback packet includes reason + all 3 annotations in order.
incentive: Non-negotiable gating: plans cannot progress without explicit human decision

title: Browse and restore prior plan versions
intent: Reviewer can step through a plan's version history, compare against current, and optionally restore an older version
acceptance: Sidebar 'Versions' tab lists all versions with heading + timestamp + word count; clicking a version loads it as read-only overlay; 'Restore' button on old version loads it as current; diff view shows changes from previous version; version slug preserves heading + date
anti_patterns: version numbers reset or skip on plan resubmit
version browser cannot restore if file system deletes old versions
clicking version does not show diff context (just shows it)
version slug collision when same heading on same day but different plan
interactions: sidebar → Versions tab → list of timestamps → click v003 → loads in overlay with restore button → diff view shows changes since v002 → click restore → v003 becomes current
current plan marked with badge or highlight
critique_focus: Storage integrity after restore; version numbering stability; diff performance with many versions (>100)
manual_simulation: 1. Deny a plan 3 times. 2. Open Versions tab. 3. See 4 versions (original + 3 denies). 4. Click v001, see 'Restore' button. 5. Click restore, confirm plan returns to v001 state. 6. New version created as v005.
incentive: Reviewers can spot regressions; agent can rollback without re-editing

title: Plan diff with line-level highlighting
intent: When agent resubmits a plan after denial, show what changed: new sections, modified steps, deleted content
acceptance: Diff badge shows +N/-M line counts below plan card; clicking toggles between normal and diff view; diff view color-codes: green (added), red (removed), yellow (modified); block-level annotations on added/removed/modified sections; diff reset after navigation; render mode (clean vs raw) user-configurable
anti_patterns: diff computed but not cached (slow on large plans)
diff does not preserve block structure (becomes hard to read)
deleted sections cannot be re-added by comment (permanent)
diff view loses annotations from normal view
interactions: plan resubmitted after denial → diff badge appears → click badge → view switches to diff mode
green highlights show new content; red shows what was removed or changed
annnotate a green section → annotation tagged [In diff content]
switch back to normal view → diff dismissed, annotations preserved
critique_focus: Diff performance (line count limits); multi-block deletion diffs; false positives from formatting changes (trailing whitespace)
manual_simulation: 1. Deny plan with comment 'add error handling'. 2. Agent adds 8 lines, removes 2, reorders 3. 3. Plan reloads with diff badge '+8/-2'. 4. Click badge, see green/red highlights. 5. Annotate green section 'good, but check unit tests'. 6. Approve with diff annotation. 7. Feedback includes '[In diff content] good...'
incentive: Reviewers focus on changes, not re-reading unchanged sections

title: Render Plannotator Flavored Markdown in plan viewer
intent: Agent plans use PFM features (code-file links, callouts, tables, diagrams, task lists); render them faithfully to show intent before approval
acceptance: Code blocks with language render with syntax highlighting; `[code.ts](./src/code.ts)` links become annotated file references; GitHub alerts (`> [!NOTE]`) become styled callouts; tables render with borders/copy buttons; task lists show checkboxes; `:::callout` directive blocks render as cards; emoji render inline; URLs auto-linkify
anti_patterns: PFM links not validated (broken paths accepted)
code block rendering fails for unknown language (shows raw)
tables overflow plan panel (no horizontal scroll)
callout styles conflict with highlight colors
interactions: plan contains '[code.ts](./src/code.ts)' → renders as blue link with file icon
plan contains '> [!WARNING] ...' → renders as orange box with icon
click code-file link → tooltip shows file status (found/ambiguous/missing)
critique_focus: Rendering fidelity vs performance (large plans with many code blocks); accessibility of rendered vs raw markdown
manual_simulation: 1. Load plan with mixed PFM: file link, callout, table, task list. 2. All render visually. 3. Click file link, verify status popup. 4. Click callout, no action (styling only). 5. Table scrolls horizontally on mobile. 6. Task list items show checkbox state (not interactive).
incentive: Reviewers see agent intent accurately; agent can use rich formats without worrying about fallback

title: Share plan with annotations via encrypted short URL
intent: Reviewer can share annotated plan with colleagues; short URL prevents huge hashes; encryption keeps plan private; no server storage of plaintext
acceptance: Plan + annotations fit in URL hash → shared as URL hash (no server call). Plan + annotations too large → user confirms → POST to paste service → receive short URL (`share.plannotator.ai/<id>`) → decryption key in URL fragment → server stores only ciphertext (AES-256-GCM) → 7-day auto-delete; sharing disabled if PLANNOTATOR_SHARE=disabled; custom paste URL supported via PLANNOTATOR_PASTE_URL env
anti_patterns: short URL created without user confirmation (surprise privacy change)
encryption key logged or sent to server (defeats zero-knowledge)
paste service stores plaintext (readable by operator)
interactions: click 'Share' button → modal: 'Plan fits in URL' or 'Too large, create short URL?' → confirm → copy short link → paste in chat/issue
colleague opens link → decryption automatic → plan + annotations load → read-only
7 days later → paste auto-deleted, URL returns 404
critique_focus: Encryption performance (streaming for very large plans); key derivation security; paste service CORS/rate limiting; mobile-friendly sharing
manual_simulation: 1. Load plan with 5 annotations. 2. Click Share. 3. Hash is 1KB, fits in URL → show URL. 4. Copy and paste in new tab, plan loads. 5. Add 20 more annotations. 6. Click Share, estimated size > 5KB → 'Create short URL?' → confirm → paste service receives ciphertext → short URL returned → verify expiration label '(deletes in 7 days)'.
incentive: Async review workflow: not all reviewers present; sharing keeps review outside chat logs

title: Recognize 'task' spec block type in plan
intent: Agent can embed structured task metadata in plan (title, owner, due date, success criteria); Fulcrum extracts as work items without manual copying
acceptance: Plan contains:```task\ntitle: ..., owner: ..., due: 2026-05-20, success: [...], depends: [...] \n``` Block type = 'task'; rendered as card with fields; export extracts tasks as JSON array; Fulcrum ingest creates work items with trace back to plan version; task title required, others optional
anti_patterns: task block missing title but other fields present (unclear work)
task owner not validated against workspace members (dangling ref)
success criteria list unparseable (free text instead of items)
interactions: agent writes plan with task blocks → 'Extract tasks from plan' button appears in review UI → click → preview shows 3 tasks → confirm extraction → Fulcrum creates tasks with plan link + status 'pending-extraction'
task references doc/code-file via ` [deps]` field → Fulcrum validates paths
critique_focus: Task block schema flexibility (YAML vs markdown table vs ad-hoc); due date parsing (relative like '+1w' or absolute); success criteria parsing and grouping
manual_simulation: 1. Load plan with 2 task blocks: 'Implement auth' (owner: alice, due: 2026-05-20) and 'Tests' (owner: bob, success: [passes 95%]). 2. Click 'Extract tasks'. 3. Preview shows 2 extracted tasks. 4. Confirm → Fulcrum creates tasks with plan trace. 5. Open task detail, 'Source: plan v003, line 12-18'.
incentive: Plans become executable: can extract and materialize work from planning session

title: Recognize 'dependency' spec block in plan
intent: Plan lists work dependencies (e.g., 'must finish auth before tests'); Fulcrum extracts and validates against existing work
acceptance: Block type 'dependency' with list of task refs (by title or id); rendered as linked graph; extraction creates dependency edges; validation flags broken refs (missing tasks) but does not block extraction; export includes dependency validation report
anti_patterns: broken dependency does not warn (work extracted as unreachable)
dependency graph not visualizable (hidden in task list)
interactions: plan contains 'depends: [auth-impl, schema-design]' field or separate block → review UI shows as expandable dependency graph
click dep → linked task preview appears
export → report: 'Dependencies: 2 validated, 1 missing (schema-design not found)'
critique_focus: Dependency ref resolution (title vs id vs description search); cycle detection algorithm; visualization complexity (many deps)
manual_simulation: 1. Load plan with task 'Tests' that depends on 'Auth impl'. 2. 'Auth impl' task block exists, 'Schema design' does not. 3. Extract tasks → preview shows dep graph: Tests→Auth←(Schema broken). 4. Warning: 'Schema-design not in plan; may block Tests'. 5. Confirm extraction. 6. Fulcrum creates 2 tasks; Tests has unresolved dep (red flag in task detail).
incentive: Plans surface work ordering constraints; prevents parallel execution of dependent work

title: Recognize 'dependency' spec block in plan
intent: Plan lists work dependencies (e.g., 'must finish auth before tests'); Fulcrum extracts and validates against existing work
acceptance: Block type 'dependency' with list of task refs (by title or id); rendered as linked graph; extraction creates dependency edges; validation flags broken refs (missing tasks) but does not block extraction; export includes dependency validation report
anti_patterns: broken dependency does not warn (work extracted as unreachable)
dependency graph not visualizable (hidden in task list)
interactions: plan contains 'depends: [auth-impl, schema-design]' field or separate block → review UI shows as expandable dependency graph
click dep → linked task preview appears
export → report: 'Dependencies: 2 validated, 1 missing (schema-design not found)'
critique_focus: Dependency ref resolution (title vs id vs description search); cycle detection algorithm; visualization complexity (many deps)
manual_simulation: 1. Load plan with task 'Tests' that depends on 'Auth impl'. 2. 'Auth impl' task block exists, 'Schema design' does not. 3. Extract tasks → preview shows dep graph: Tests→Auth←(Schema broken). 4. Warning: 'Schema-design not in plan; may block Tests'. 5. Confirm extraction. 6. Fulcrum creates 2 tasks; Tests has unresolved dep (red flag in task detail).
incentive: Plans surface work ordering constraints; prevents parallel execution of dependent work

title: Recognize 'success-criteria' spec block in plan
intent: Plan contains acceptance criteria (user-facing or tech); Fulcrum extracts to task success checklist, prevents approval until criteria defined
acceptance: Block type 'success-criteria' with list of checkpoints; rendered as badge + count in review; task extraction includes success-criteria as checklist items; plan UI can warn 'no success criteria found' if task block present but success block missing; success criteria optional if no task block present
anti_patterns: success criteria defined in task block and separate block (duplication)
success criteria extracted but task not created (orphaned checklist)
task approved without confirming success criteria exist
interactions: plan contains '# Success Criteria' block with list → review UI highlights as success-criteria type
extract tasks → success criteria automatically grouped with task → Fulcrum task shows checklist section
if task block exists but no success block, warning banner: 'Consider adding success criteria'
critique_focus: Distinguishing success criteria from regular lists (heading heuristic vs explicit block type); checklist state persistence (who marks done); measurability validation
manual_simulation: 1. Load plan with task block (no success criteria) and annotation. 2. Warning banner appears. 3. Hover → 'This task has no success criteria; link a block or add to task.block'. 4. Agent revises, adds success-criteria block. 5. Plan v002 loads, warning gone. 6. Extract tasks → task shows 4 checklist items from success block.
incentive: Prevents work items without acceptance criteria; forces clarity before execution

title: Recognize 'prototype' callout in plan for ref paths
intent: Plan lists prototype or proof-of-concept file paths (e.g., 'See proto in ./src/proto.ts'); Fulcrum validates paths and links prototype artifacts to task
acceptance:
Plan contains `[prototype](./src/proto.ts)` or `:::prototype
path: ./src/proto.ts
reason: shows auth flow
:::` → rendered with file status badge (found/ambiguous/missing); extraction associates prototype path with task; Fulcrum can navigate from task to prototype; broken proto paths warn but do not block task extraction
anti_patterns: prototype path not validated (broken links in task)
multiple prototypes in plan create ambiguity (which proto for which task)
prototype reason not captured (why this file matters unclear)
interactions: plan contains proto link → review UI shows file status (checkmark or warning)
extract tasks → prototype paths included in task metadata
open extracted task → 'Prototypes' section shows linked files with reason
critique_focus: Path ambiguity (multiple files match pattern); relative vs absolute path handling; prototype lifecycle (when to archive/remove)
manual_simulation: 1. Load plan with proto: '[proto: ./src/auth.ts](reason: shows OAuth flow)'. 2. File exists → checkmark. 3. Change to './src/missing.ts' → red X. 4. Extract tasks, task shows 1 prototype (auth.ts) + reason. 5. Open task detail, click proto link → opens editor at file.
incentive: Reviewers can validate plan references before approving; extracted tasks have concrete proofs

title: Recognize 'verify-end-to-end' spec block for task validation
intent: Plan specifies end-to-end test or validation step; Fulcrum auto-creates a 'verify' task after main task to ensure validation is not skipped
acceptance: Block type 'verify-end-to-end' with validation steps; extracted task automatically creates follow-up 'verify' task with dependency on original; verify task inherits success criteria; verify task assigned to same owner by default; plan warns if main task lacks verify block (optional but recommended)
anti_patterns: verify task created but not linked as dependency (can run before main)
verify task success criteria generic (not copied from main)
multiple verify blocks for one task (ambiguous)
verify task created but main task not extracted
interactions: task block followed by verify-end-to-end block → extraction creates 2 tasks: 'Implement auth' and 'Verify auth (e2e)' with dependency
verify task has 'verify-end-to-end' label and same owner
task detail shows linked verify task in Dependencies section
critique_focus: Verify task naming conventions (avoid collision); success criteria inheritance vs override; verify scope (all code paths or smoke test)
manual_simulation: 1. Load plan: 'Implement auth' task + 'verify-end-to-end' block (steps: test OAuth, test session). 2. Extract → 2 tasks created. 3. 'Implement auth' has outbound dep 'Verify auth (e2e)'. 4. Verify task shows checklist from e2e block. 5. Task board shows auth task with verify subtask. 6. Approve verify task only after main task done.
incentive: Prevents shipping untested work; verification baked into task extraction, not afterthought

title: Confirm plan materialization before creating tasks
intent: After plan approval, reviewer sees preview of extracted tasks, success criteria, dependencies before Fulcrum commits them to project
acceptance: Approval flow: approve plan → materialize confirmation modal shows: task count, dependency graph preview, success criteria summary, owner assignments, due dates; cancel returns to plan; confirm creates all tasks and emits 'work.created' events with plan trace; failed task creation rolls back partial state and shows error report
anti_patterns: materialize happens silently without preview (no chance to correct)
partial failure (3/5 tasks created) leaves inconsistent state
materialize confirmation blocks for minutes (UX hangs)
interactions: approve plan → modal: 'Materialize 3 tasks?' → shows summary + graph → cancel or confirm → confirm → progress bar → '3 tasks created' → navigate to board
if error: 'Task 2 owner not found (alice@x)' → show error, ask retry/fix/cancel
critique_focus: Materialization rollback reliability; dependency cycle detection; concurrent task creation (race conditions); performance with 50+ tasks
manual_simulation: 1. Approve plan with 3 tasks and 2 deps. 2. Confirmation modal shows: '3 tasks, 2 dependencies, 0 owners missing'. 3. Dependency graph shows task order. 4. Click confirm → progress → '3 tasks created'. 5. Navigate to board, all 3 tasks appear with deps linked. 6. Change owner to invalid email in plan, reapprove → error 'alice@x not a workspace member' → cancel, fix plan, retry.
incentive: Last gate before work creation; prevents bad data entry; clear error recovery

title: Annotate arbitrary markdown file or folder with plan review UI
intent: Reviewer can annotate spec, ADR, or design doc (not just code diffs); inline feedback on markdown structure and content
acceptance: Command: `/plannotator-annotate spec.md` → loads markdown in plan review UI → same annotation types (deletion, comment, global) apply; export includes file path + line ranges + feedback; folder input opens file picker → select file → annotate; URLs fetched via Jina or Turndown; HTML files supported
anti_patterns: markdown links not validated (broken refs accepted)
folder input shows too many files (UX overload)
URL fetch times out (no timeout feedback)
exported annotations lack file path context
interactions: run `/plannotator-annotate README.md` → loads in plan review UI → select section → comment 'expand this' → approve → feedback sent to agent
or `/plannotator-annotate https://example.com/spec` → fetches, renders, annotate, export
critique_focus: Performance with large markdown files (>100KB); folder traversal limits; URL whitelist/blacklist
manual_simulation: 1. Run `/plannotator-annotate docs/design.md`. 2. 3 comments added on sections. 3. Approve → feedback: 'File: docs/design.md, section: Architecture, [comment] expand options'. 4. Agent sees feedback and updates file.
incentive: Documentation review integrated with plan/code review; no tool switching

title: Archive approved and denied plan decisions for audit and learning
intent: Reviewer can browse past plan decisions (approved/denied + reason) for same repo or project; enables pattern analysis and consistency checking
acceptance: Archive stored at `~/.plannotator/plans/` per project; each decision saved with: plan heading, version slug, decision (approve/deny), reason, timestamp, reviewer identity, all annotations; archive sidebar tab in plan review UI or standalone archive mode; entries tagged by project/date; search by heading or decision type; no deletion (immutable log)
anti_patterns: decision stored but reason omitted (cannot audit why)
archive not searchable (must scroll through 100+ entries)
reviewer identity not captured (unknown who approved/denied)
interactions: sidebar → Archive tab → list of past decisions with badges (approve: green, deny: red) → click entry → read-only view of plan + annotations + decision reason + timestamp
search → 'deny' → filter to only denied plans → click one → see why it was rejected
critique_focus: Storage cleanup (archive size limits); multi-reviewer auditing; bulk export for compliance reports
manual_simulation: 1. Approve and deny 3 plans over time. 2. Sidebar Archive tab shows 3 entries with badges. 3. Click denied plan, see reason: 'Reorder steps'. 4. Click approved plan, see decision time. 5. Search 'deny' → 1 entry shown. 6. Export archive as JSON for compliance audit.
incentive: Audit trail for decisions; reviewers can learn from past patterns

title: Annotate images in plan with boxes and arrows
intent: Plan includes PNG/JPG/SVG diagrams; reviewer can draw boxes or arrows to highlight specific areas, add comments to annotations
acceptance: Plan contains image block → click image → canvas opens → draw box/arrow/highlight → label with comment → save → annotation persists in plan version; export includes image annotation as reference (link + comment); image attachments can be added to comments
anti_patterns: image annotations cannot be undone (stuck with wrong markup)
annotations lost when plan version changes (no version context)
image too small to annotate (no zoom)
exported annotations lack image reference (cannot locate visually)
interactions: plan shows architecture diagram → click image → annotation toolbar appears → draw box on login box → label 'missing error handling' → save → box appears on image as persistent annotation
export → 'Image: architecture.png, annotation: [box at x:100,y:50] missing error handling'
critique_focus: Canvas performance with large images; touch/trackpad support for drawing; annotation undo/redo
manual_simulation: 1. Plan shows swimlane diagram. 2. Click diagram, canvas opens. 3. Draw box around 'Auth' lane. 4. Label 'add user session expiry'. 5. Save → box visible on diagram. 6. Approve → export includes image annotation. 7. Agent sees 'add user session expiry' on diagram.
incentive: Visual feedback on architecture/design diagrams; agent can refine specific diagram elements

title: Mobile-friendly plan reader (read-only, no annotations)
intent: Reviewer on mobile can read shared plan URL and understand structure, but cannot add annotations (constraints of small screen)
acceptance: Shared plan URL on mobile: renders plan markdown, no annotation toolbar, sidebar collapses to hamburger, touch-friendly font sizes, no text selection (cannot trigger highlight); annotations from original reviewer visible as read-only; back button returns to browser history; plan text should reflow at 320px width
anti_patterns: toolbar buttons visible but non-functional on mobile (confusing)
sidebar takes 80% of screen (cannot read plan)
links open in same tab (loses plan context)
interactions: paste shared plan URL on iPhone → plan loads, readable font, no toolbar → scroll to section → annotations visible as margin badges → click annotation → expand comment popover
click doc link → opens in new tab
critique_focus: Performance on 3G networks; touch precision for link taps; viewport meta tags; font sizing for readability
manual_simulation: 1. Generate shared plan URL on desktop. 2. Paste in iPhone Safari. 3. Plan loads, renders full-width. 4. Scroll sections, annotations visible. 5. Click comment → popover expands. 6. Try to select text → no highlight toolbar (not available on mobile). 7. All readable without pinch-zoom.
incentive: Async review on mobile; busy reviewers can catch plan decisions without desktop

title: Plan validation errors block extraction (missing success criteria, broken deps)
intent: Prevent materializing broken tasks: if success criteria missing or dependency cycle detected, extraction shows error and requires fix before creating tasks
acceptance: Plan validation checks: (1) every task has success criteria block, (2) no circular dependencies, (3) all dependency refs valid, (4) owner field assigned valid member; errors shown as banner with fix hints; extraction blocked until errors cleared; warning (non-blocking) for best practices (e.g., 'no prototype link for this task')
anti_patterns: validation error shown but extraction allowed (bypass)
error message is cryptic ('invalid task block') instead of actionable ('task on line 23 missing success criteria')
error does not include fix suggestion (user must re-read plan to understand)
